hooks.command:
INPUT=$(cat); if echo "$INPUT" | grep -qE 'npm[[:space:]]+(install|ci|update|add|i)([[:space:]"]|$)' && ! echo "$INPUT" | grep -q -- '--ignore-scripts'; then printf '── NPM INSTALL BLOCKED ──
npm commands must use --ignore-scripts and --save-exact (see CLAUDE.md).
Canonical: npm install <pkg> --save-exact --ignore-scripts
' >&2; exit 2; fi
